Definition: from G2303 and 1491; sulphur-like, i.e. sulphurous:--brimstone.
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, theiṓdēs means sulphurous, like brimstone. In Revelation 9:17, brimstone, and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions.
TheologicalSignificance: Horses breathing brimstone in John's vision give me a glimpse of judgment so dreadful that I am grateful for the cross.
